name: Fade the close-on-the-low candle in an uptrend
note: Buys the bar every shooting-star scanner reads as weakness: an open-at-high / close-at-low candle (Black Marubozu, Closing Black Marubozu or Gravestone Doji, selected by the pset bitmask 1/2/4) printing while price is above its EMA(10). Tharavanij et al. measured every bearish one-day pattern on SET50 names 2006-2016 and the nominal short lost money in all of them, so this takes the long side. No profit target by default: the published tables pair positive means with sub-0.5 win rates, a right skew a fixed target would truncate. Held `hold` bars, stopped at 2 ATR.
source: Tharavanij, Siraprapasiri & Rajchamaha (2017), 'Profitability of Candlestick Charting Patterns in the Stock Exchange of Thailand', SAGE Open, doi:10.1177/2158244017736799, Table 2 (bearish single-day patterns, 1/3/5/10-day holds, SET50 2006-2016). Pattern inequalities from Goo, Chen & Chang (2007); EMA(10) trend definition from Marshall, Young & Rose (2006).
